title: [Screen Ruler] Add haptic feedback for detected measurement edges

status.label: Canonical tracker unclear
status.detail: Open issues #50166 and #50168 have the same title and near-identical Screen Ruler haptics scope.

next_action.label: Confirm canonical Screen Ruler tracker

actions.label: Ask which Screen Ruler tracker is canonical

comment.body: Could you confirm whether #50166 or #50168 is the canonical Screen Ruler haptics implementation tracker? Both are open, have the same title, and describe the same Hover-on-stable-edge behavior under #48761/#50162. Please identify the tracker to retain and supersede the other so implementation and discussion do not split.

judgment.rationale: The two open Screen Ruler trackers appear equivalent, but no confirmed upstream relationship identifies a canonical issue.
evidence: Issue #50166 and open issue #50168 share the exact title.
Both bodies describe Hover feedback for newly detected stable measurement edges, duplicate suppression, hysteresis, throttling, and a Screen Ruler toggle.
Both reference parent #48761 and shared infrastructure #50162, but neither body or timeline identifies the other as superseded.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask the maintainer-author to designate one canonical tracker before any design or implementation work proceeds.
